svg.text: SEA / UNEVEN WAVES + COASTAL SECTION
Proposed ocean replaces the enclosing mountain ring; wave appearance is a design target, not a simulated result
BIRTHDAY CASTLE V5 / PROPOSED — APPROVAL BEFORE GAME IMPLEMENTATION
WAVE COMPOSITION / crossing swells, not equal sine stripes
Long swell + crossing wind chop + uneven wave packets + shoreline refraction. Whitecaps
appear selectively on steep crests.
SEA MATERIAL / visual specification
Deep water: indigo → teal; pearl moon glints
Shallows: turquoise, depth-dependent clarity
Windward coast: broken 1–4 m swells
Leeward coves: small ripples and soft wakes
Reefs: irregular foam and tidepool eddies
Near shore: short waves; offshore: long swell
Use Gerstner sets + normal detail + foam masks
Freeze human-scale structures; do not scale props 3×
COAST SECTION / dunes → beach → reef → shelf → open sea
Uneven dune
Wet beach
Reef pockets
Sloped shelf
Open swell
No identical ring boundary. Break up coastline and crest spacing; retain navigable harbor water and a safe dry arrival route.
